_meta.description: Mock Photo Report Records — FoodSafe Module 3 (Photo Report Module)
_meta.note: Simulates user-generated reports of suspicious food items captured via camera or image picker

reports.user_notes: Found visible green and black mold patches on 3 slices. Package was still 4 days before best-by date. Store shelf unit was damp.
reports.store_response: Staff removed the product from shelf and issued a replacement.

reports.user_notes: The 'Organic' seal printed on the bag looks different from the usual USDA seal. Colors seem slightly faded. Texture of bag feels different too.

Package had gray-green discoloration on edges. Strong sour odor when opened at home. Use-by date still valid for 2 days. Refrigerator case appeared to be malfunctioning — temperature display showed 52°F.
reports.store_response: Manager acknowledged the refrigeration unit had an overnight malfunction. Section was pulled for inspection.

reports.user_notes: Found a small hard dark fragment (approx 3mm) embedded in the peanut butter about halfway through the jar. Looks like it could be plastic or charred material. Lot code: 2025NOV14B.
Scanned to verify. Seal intact, no bulging, smell normal, within date. Traceability lookup showed PASS on all QC checks.
App flagged this product as RECALLED when I scanned the QR code. Product is still on the shelf 2 days after the recall was issued. Photographed for record.

recall_info.reason: Pesticide residue — Imidacloprid exceeds EPA tolerance

reports.store_response: Staff immediately pulled all units from shelf.

reports.user_notes: Deep dent on the side seam of the can. Not a cosmetic dent — the seam itself appears compromised. No bulging but dent is along the seam joint.
reports.food_safety_risk_note: Seam dents on canned goods can break the hermetic seal, creating anaerobic conditions favorable for Clostridium botulinum. Do not purchase.

reports.user_notes: Use-by date is May 28, 2026. Today is June 5 — product is 8 days past its USE BY date (not best-by — this is a safety date). Multiple units on shelf all expired.
reports.store_response: Pharmacist called manager; full shelf section removed.

location.store: Airport convenience store — DFW Terminal D

reports.user_notes: Ingredient list shows 'contains: almonds, cashews, peanuts' but the allergen Contains statement on back only says 'Contains: TREE NUTS.' Peanuts are NOT tree nuts — they are legumes. Peanut allergy is separate from tree nut allergy. This may be a labeling error that could seriously harm someone with peanut allergy.
reports.regulatory_concern: Under FALCPA, peanuts must be declared separately from tree nuts. This label appears non-compliant.

reports.user_notes: Jar has no barcode, no manufacturer address, no country of origin, and no net weight declaration — all required under 21 CFR 101. Label only says 'Pure Honey' with a hand-drawn bee. Vendor could not provide any traceability information when asked.
reports.regulatory_concern: Missing multiple mandatory label elements under 21 CFR Part 101. No way to verify safety or origin.

visible_mold.label: Visible mold growth
visible_mold.action: Do not consume. Dispose of product.

off_color.label: Abnormal color change
off_color.action: Compare to normal product appearance. When in doubt, discard.

off_odor.label: Abnormal or sour smell
off_odor.action: Do not taste. Discard if odor is sour, putrid, or strongly uncharacteristic.

color_change_gray.label: Gray/green discoloration (meat)
color_change_gray.action: Discard immediately. May indicate bacterial spoilage or temperature abuse.

temperature_abuse_suspected.label: Suspected temperature abuse
temperature_abuse_suspected.action: Report to store. Do not purchase. Check if refrigeration unit is malfunctioning.

foreign_object_physical.label: Foreign object in product
foreign_object_physical.action: Do not consume. Keep the object as evidence. Report to FDA MedWatch and manufacturer.

packaging_seam_damage.label: Damaged can seam
packaging_seam_damage.action: Do not purchase or consume. Risk of Clostridium botulinum contamination.

past_use_by_date.label: Past Use By date
past_use_by_date.action: Do not consume. 'Use By' is a food safety date, not just quality.

label_irregularity.label: Label appears irregular or inconsistent
label_irregularity.action: Report to store. May indicate counterfeit, mislabeled, or recalled product.

packaging_anomaly.label: Unusual packaging appearance
packaging_anomaly.action: Inspect carefully. Compare with known genuine product.

allergen_label_incomplete.label: Allergen declaration appears incomplete
allergen_label_incomplete.action: Do not consume if you have the suspected allergen. Report to FDA.

active_fda_recall.label: Active FDA recall detected
active_fda_recall.action: Do not consume. Return to store for refund or dispose of product.

missing_required_label_info.label: Missing required label information
missing_required_label_info.action: Avoid purchase. Report to local health authority if sold in a store.
